name: What is the typical process for interior damage repair with City Dweller?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for interior damage repair with City Dweller?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our repair process begins with an initial inspection to accurately assess the damage and determine the scope of work. We then provide a detailed estimate outlining the necessary repairs, materials, and timeline. Upon approval, our skilled technicians will proceed with the repairs, keeping you informed throughout the project. We ensure thorough cleanup and a final walkthrough to confirm your satisfaction with the restored interior.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an inspection, detailed estimate, repair work, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
